prior_exposure: Original market outcomes, admission failures and first mechanism diagnostic results are already known. This is a new bounded explanatory contrast chosen after those results; no freshblind or confirmatory causal claim.
question: Among every same-actual-ID/target/technicaleta/H/L/cost/kernel pair in the original11-case inventory with different training fans, does changing only the forecastfan explain the first difference in their stored actions at the same state? What is the local effect of removing the actualID from the full fan?

selection_rule.input: All original11 cases in the frozen parent inventory, not a chosen subset of their outcomes.
selection_rule.algorithm: Sort caseIDs and inspect all55 unordered pairs using metadata only; retain every pair equal in original scenarioID, target vector, annualeta, originalH, L, cost, four execution-kernel sourceSHA maps and original development-arraySHA, but with different ordered trainingID lists.
selection_rule.excluded_from_execution_equality: Trainingbeta/staticgamma are recorded but do not independently enter execution after target andeta are fixed. Their equality is not required by matching; no fitting is repeated.
selection_rule.current_metadata_result: Exactly one eligible pair: full_112 versus outer_r5_112, same45/5/50 andeta.03, full120 versusouter96. All selected pairs retained.

state_design.tau: First difference of the two ORIGINAL saved model action strings across original30years, one-based output. No disagreement meansNULL, threeNULL Q rows retained, no replacement date or case.
state_design.preconditions: tau>=2 and both original accounts active. Compare every endpoint0..tau-1 for holdings/weights/nominal+realwealth/CPI/realpeak/currentDD/runningMDD/absorbingflag, plus all preceding posttradeholdings/fees/moved/targetexecution/pending/trades. Discrete fields exact; numeric source-roundoff toleranceatol2e-10,rtol5e-13, with actual maximum errors and exact flags saved. No breachthreshold relaxation.
state_design.common_state: Use full120 model predecision state at tau for every fan. Outer96 prior state must pass identical-history check. Carry actualholdings/CPI/peak/MDD/flag and originalH, not a restarted account.
state_design.original_reproduction: For full120 andouter96 recomputed Qg hold/restore and technicalscore must match each corresponding savedtau Q/score within source-roundoff tolerance; integerbadcounts,fanN,action/reason exact. Any failure aborts publication, no new year/target/eta fallback.

limitations: Post-hoc case family derived from known failures; metadata matching is outcome-free within that family but does not make the family representative or restoreblindness.

At a truly same state,target,eta andkernel, a changed action under the two given fans is a model-internal result of that particular forecastfan replacement. It does not establish which forecast is true or that the decision error caused a futureloss.
120 includes actualscenario112 and is trainingresubstitution, not heldout forecasting;119 deletion removes only that fixed-state self member and is neither fulllearnerLOOCV nor a completed119-policy.
119to96 also removes23other fanmembers; the two-step bridge is a declared decomposition, not unique causal contributions ofselfinclusion,sample size,calendar dependence or particularmarkets.
Original full-H outcome differences include all later differing decisions/pendingfeedback. They cannot be attributed quantitatively to the first action or this same-state score contrast alone.
